from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "Prerequisite: The Dot Product",
            [
                "The dot product measures similarity between two vectors.",
                "Aligned vectors produce a high positive score.",
                "High scores signal that the model recognizes a concept."
            ]
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Origin for vectors
        origin = self.grid["D3"]
        
        # Create vectors
        # Vector 1 (Fixed)
        v1_end = origin + RIGHT * 1.8 + UP * 0.5
        vector_france = Arrow(origin, v1_end, buff=0, color=WHITE, stroke_width=6)
        
        # Vector 2 (Rotating) - initially at an angle
        angle_tracker = ValueTracker(PI/3)
        
        # Using a function to create the second arrow based on angle
        def get_v2():
            start = origin
            end = origin + 1.8 * (np.cos(angle_tracker.get_value()) * RIGHT + np.sin(angle_tracker.get_value()) * UP)
            return Arrow(start, end, buff=0, color=WHITE, stroke_width=6)

        vector_pattern = always_redraw(get_v2) # Allowed for simple geometry like Arrow, but I'll be careful

        self.play(Create(vector_france), Create(vector_pattern))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)

        # Similarity Bar setup
        bar_bg = Rectangle(width=3, height=0.4, color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)
        self.place_in_area(bar_bg, "F2", "F5")
        
        # Bar fill
        # Fill width depends on the dot product (cosine of angle if normalized)
        # We'll map the angle PI/3 -> 0 to fill 0 -> 100%
        # Start angle is PI/3 (~60 deg), target is PI/6 or 15 deg (the angle of v1)
        target_angle = np.arctan2(0.5, 1.8) # angle of v1
        start_angle = target_angle + PI/3

        angle_tracker.set_value(start_angle)

        def get_fill():
            # calculate similarity: cos(theta)
            current_angle = angle_tracker.get_value()
            diff = abs(current_angle - target_angle)
            similarity = np.cos(diff)
            # Normalize for bar width: mapping similarity [0.5, 1.0] to [0.1, 1.0]
            fill_ratio = max(0.1, (similarity - 0.5) / 0.5)
            
            fill = Rectangle(
                width=bar_bg.width * fill_ratio,
                height=bar_bg.height,
                fill_color="#00FF00",
                fill_opacity=0.8,
                stroke_width=0
            )
            fill.align_to(bar_bg, LEFT)
            return fill

        bar_fill = always_redraw(get_fill)
        bar_label = Text("Similarity", font_size=18).next_to(bar_bg, UP, buff=0.1)

        self.play(Create(bar_bg), FadeIn(bar_label))
        self.add(bar_fill)
        
        # Rotate vectors to align
        self.play(
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(target_angle),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)

        # Labels for vectors
        label_france = Text("France", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        label_pattern = Text("Pattern", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        
        # Position labels near the arrows
        label_france.next_to(v1_end, UR, buff=0.1)
        
        # Update function for pattern label to follow the arrow
        label_pattern.add_updater(lambda m: m.next_to(vector_pattern.get_end(), DR, buff=0.1))

        self.play(Write(label_france), Write(label_pattern))
        
        # Pulse the Similarity bar
        self.play(
            bar_fill.animate.scale(1.1),
            bar_bg.animate.scale(1.1),
            rate_func=there_and_back,
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # Cleanup
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(vector_france, vector_pattern, bar_bg, bar_fill, bar_label, label_france, label_pattern)))
